entries.prompt: Create a precise high-resolution GAME ART UPGRADE DESIGN SHEET for the ARROW TOWER only, four equally spaced columns on a warm ivory background. Input 1 is the user's strict smooth sculpted 3D pre-render style and arrow upgrade reference. Input 2 is the already drafted first-level arrow tower, preserve this identity. Input 3 provides earlier upgrade STRUCTURE only, not its pixel texture. Title in Chinese: 箭塔 · 主体结构升级. Four labels under columns: 1级, 4级, 8级, 12级. All four towers have the same elevated three-quarter camera, warm upper-left key light, soft grounded cast shadows, refined bevelled honey-brown timber, rounded pale-grey foundation stones, crisp smooth edges and subtle wood detail exactly like input 1. Full towers visible, aligned on a shared baseline, no overlap. Make each stage visually distinct by STRUCTURE, not recoloring. Stage 1: short compact open wooden support frame, small simple railing deck, one crossbow, exactly the existing first-stage sample. Stage 4: noticeably taller braced support frame with a wooden front ladder, enlarged full upper railing and single larger crossbow. Stage 8: a sturdy intermediate wooden deck with a projecting short eave around it, heavy supporting posts and cross braces, front ladder, small rust-orange side pennants, one heavy crossbow on the top railing deck. Stage 12: much stronger and broader full-height heavy cross-braced timber body, thick golden-brass bolted corner reinforcements, broad upper fighting deck with TWO compact parallel crossbows, rust-orange pennants, chunky stone foundations. Maximum stage 12 physical height approximately 1.35 times stage 1 and foundation width 1.25 times stage 1; avoid a giant new building. The degree of structure change must be obvious at phone sprite size. Crossbows and upper front/back rail occlusion correct, arrows point toward the same upper-right direction. No people, no pixel art, no black outlines, no noisy painterly finish. Use the reference's friendly rich material quality, no fantasy spikes or machinery, no new UI elements beyond title and level labels. Small restrained gold progression arrows between the columns. This is a concept comparison sheet, not claimed to be the finished game. Render each tower large and detailed, landscape 2048x1024.

Create a high-resolution GAME ART UPGRADE DESIGN SHEET for the STONE / SLING TOWER only. Four towers in four evenly spaced columns on warm ivory background, shared baseline, all fully visible. Image 1 is the user's strict sculpted 3D-pre-render style, light and clarity. Image 2 is the approved-direction first-level stone tower candidate: preserve the circular warm-grey chunky stone masonry and the wooden Y sling identity. Image 3 supplies the old stone tower upgrade structures only, NOT pixel art style. Title: 石塔 · 主体结构升级. Four labels: 1级, 4级, 8级, 12级. Stage 1 is a squat two-course rounded stone turret, tiny arched front opening, compact two-post wooden sling with leather pouch and one stone. Stage 4 adds a clear additional cylindrical stone course above a distinct arched foundation, a thicker raised parapet ring and taller heavy sling posts; overall visibly more substantial, still compact. Stage 8 has a strongly flared lower masonry skirt with large radial wedge stone buttresses, deeper stone arches, heavy upper parapet and a widened, visibly stronger sling mechanism with thick rope and leather pouch. Stage 12 has a fortress-like reinforced flared round stone foundation, pronounced squared stone buttresses spaced around the ring, a continuous thick brass-bracketed middle reinforcement ring, bolted gold-brass hinge caps on the upper sling posts, and the largest visibly taut heavy sling with one larger boulder. Each stage must differ in structural silhouette and masonry mass, not just an ornament or color. Keep a restrained village military feeling, no modern cannon, no wheels, no guns, no magical effects. Consistent 25-degree elevated orthographic three-quarter camera and upper-left warm lighting; rounded softly sculpted stone, honey timber, rich restrained material detail and soft cast shadow. Limit final height to about 1.35 times first and footprint width to 1.25 times first. Tiny grass at foundation, no broad scenery. Gentle gold progression arrows between columns. No people, no extra towers, no pixel art, no black outlines, no watercolor texture. Large detailed artwork, landscape 2048x1024. This is a concept sheet, not a game screenshot.

Create a detailed high-resolution GAME ART UPGRADE DESIGN SHEET for the FROST TOWER only. Four equally spaced full towers on a warm ivory background, shared baseline and same camera, large readable silhouettes. Image 1 is the strict rounded high-quality sculpted 3D pre-render art style and lighting. Image 2 is the current first-tier frost tower identity. Image 3 supplies frost tower upgrade STRUCTURE only, not pixel textures. Chinese title: 寒塔 · 主体结构升级. Level labels: 1级, 4级, 8级, 12级. Stage 1: a very compact single-roof timber pavilion on grey stone feet, golden ochre curved roof tiles, one small cyan crystal in a brass socket, little cream side strips and cyan diamond on the front. Stage 4: broader timber pavilion, a larger visibly curved JADE-TEAL tiled single roof with upturned tips, larger single crystal in a solid brass socket, sturdier warm timber columns and dark recess under roof, small pale side pennants. Stage 8: visibly TWO stacked layers of jade-teal tiled eaves around a taller timber core, one central cyan crystal with TWO smaller crystals beside it in the top socket, stronger stone foundations, small cream patterned side flags. Stage 12: broad reinforced TWO-TIER pavilion with deep, beautifully curved jade roof eaves, substantial gold-brass corner fittings and braces, three clearly faceted ice crystals (center largest), heavier stone foundation and taller front timber entrance panel with cyan diamond. Strong structural change across stages, not merely more decorations; modest progression, final height at most 1.35 times stage 1, footprint width about 1.25 times stage 1. All towers in the same elevated three-quarter orthographic view, warm upper-left light, soft contact/cast shadows. Preserve warm timber village identity and fine sculpted materials; crystals cyan but restrained, NO luminous haze, particles, magic beams, oversized glowing halos, modern tech or sci-fi. Small tufts only at foundation. Use rich clear rounded tile, timber, stone and metal surfaces matching reference 1 exactly in detail. No people, no pixel art, no black outlines, no painterly texture, no unrelated objects. Small gold progression arrows. Landscape 2048x1024, concept sheet, not a game screenshot.

Create a high-resolution HOUSE UPGRADE AND EXPANSION DESIGN SHEET for the Chinese village game. Input 1 is the STRICT smooth sculpted 3D pre-render reference, especially the two golden-roof village homes in its gameplay. Input 2 supplies earlier housing progression structure ONLY, not pixel texture. Warm ivory background, elegant restrained gold separators, large polished highly detailed houses, fixed elevated orthographic three-quarter camera, upper-left warm light, soft ground shadows. Title: 民居 · 修缮与扩建. TWO ROWS, FOUR columns. Upper row heading 修缮升级. Columns labeled 1级, 4级, 8级, 12级. Level 1: the reference's cozy compact single-storey cream-plaster and thick honey timber home, plump golden-ochre layered thatch roof, dark wooden central door, small clear square side windows, small grey foundation stones. Level 4: similarly compact but sturdier one-storey cottage with rich terra-cotta curved tiled roof, substantial timber entry canopy, circular side window, short broad stone steps. Level 8: compact two-storey house, jade-teal curved tiled roofs, little upper balcony, wide warm timber structure and cream infill, restrained lanterns. Level 12: refined two-storey home, broader clearly articulated jade roof, decorative but restrained golden ridge end caps, prominent central upper front room, strong plinth, refined dark wooden double door and small lanterns. Structural difference must be clear, no giant mansion, maximum silhouette height ~1.4 times first house. Lower row heading 扩建 · 新增房间看得见. Four groups each containing exactly TWO separate homes representing existing paired village buildings: label 2间 shows two simple compact single-room golden-roof homes; 3间 shows left house with one compact attached side-room, right unchanged; 4间 shows each house with one compact side-room; 5间 shows left house with attached side-room and one small raised upper room, right house with attached side-room. Keep expansion examples all in the same golden-ochre roof family and identical main modules so expansion is obvious, not random redesign. Preserve ample clear walking space between paired houses; no walls crossing the passage. Clear roof depth and smooth rounded timber, stone and ceramic, same fine quality as input1; tiny grass at foundations only, no bush masses hiding doors. No people, no front fences, no extra buildings, no pixel art, no black outline, no painterly canvas grain. Large landscape 2048x1536 concept artwork, not a game screenshot.

Create one high-resolution VILLAGE FACILITY UPGRADE DESIGN SHEET, 3 rows by 4 columns, spacious warm ivory background. Reference image 1 is the strict final sculpted 3D pre-render style, quality, light and first-tier village architecture. Reference image 2 supplies upgrade structure only, NOT pixel textures. Title: 村庄设施 · 主体结构升级. Column headings: 1级, 4级, 8级, 12级. Row labels: 农田, 伐木场, 城门. Every cell large, full object, same elevated orthographic three-quarter camera except gate nearly front-facing as in gameplay. All materials warm, smoothly bevelled, richly dimensional with upper-left soft sunlight and restrained cast shadows. Farm row: all four stages retain a compact 2 by 2 arrangement of FOUR open wheat beds with accessible walking gaps, NO tall fence, NO railing around crops. Stage1 wooden soil beds and bright plump golden wheat matching input1. Stage4 strengthened low stone/wood soil edges and a modest slim irrigation gutter along one outside edge, still open between beds. Stage8 better defined stone irrigation channels and ONE small rear-side wooden water wheel with clearly separate wheel pivot. Stage12 a refined compact stone rear water supply basin and stronger water wheel frame, denser but readable golden crops, never tall walls blocking a villager standing on the beds. Logging row: stage1 the reference's small golden-thatch open wooden shed with a small round-cut log stack beside it; stage4 a terra-cotta roof work shed with front awning and modest hand-saw workbench; stage8 a substantial jade-roof timber workshop with an independently articulated side wheel and saw assembly; stage12 a compact two-level jade-roof timber workshop with a strong stone plinth, organized visible log storage and one central saw workbench. Gate row: stage1 the reference's cozy broad ochre-golden curved-roof warm timber gate with a central double wooden door and small pale stone feet; stage4 terra-cotta tile roof with stronger stone side piers and heavier double door; stage8 teal curved tile roof over a broad rounded stone arch with deep warm wood doors and restrained brass details; stage12 compact two-tier teal-roof gatehouse with stone piers and two-storey timber central bay, not a giant castle. No attached long side walls or towers. Upgrades clearly change structural silhouette and surfaces, not just decorations; cap maximum footprint growth to about 20 percent and height growth about 35 percent. Tiny grass around base only, no huge bushes masking details. No people, numbers other than level labels, UI meters, black outlines, pixelation, watercolor grain or modern machinery. Exactly match image1's crisp friendly toy-like 3D render appearance. Landscape 2048x1536, comparison concept sheet.
